semiconductor_relevance: High — Trafolo Engineering develops specialized simulation software for magnetic components in power electronics, which is crucial for semiconductor design and manufacturing.
summary: Trafolo Engineering creates advanced 3D finite element simulation software tailored for electromagnetic and heat transfer analysis in power electronics. Their tools enable R&D teams to design and test magnetic components like transformers and inductors virtually, streamlining the development process in the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: 3D finite element simulation software for magnetic components
